newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier has 125 orders for Learjet 45.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier has 125 orders for Learjet 45.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Tuesday that it has 125 firm orders for its Learjet 45 business jet.
The orders for the Learjet 45, which is in flight testing, include 100 firm orders and 25 firm positions under its FlexJet fraction ownership program.
"We now have 125 firm orders for this aircraft," Bombardier said in an announcement.
Bombardier said it also has options for an additional 25 Learjet 45 aircraft under the Flexjet program.

Under Bombardier's Flexjet program, the company has established a "bridge" program for companies and individuals to purchase shares in a Learjet 31A or Learjet 60 aircraft and transfer to their Learjet 45 when it becomes available in early 1999. There is a similar program for Bombardier's Canadair Challenger business jet.

Bombardier said certification of the Learjet 45 is expected in mid-1997, with deliveries beginning shortly afterward. Six Learjet 45 aircraft are currently in the test flight program and have accumulated almost 700 hours of total flight time.
Bombardier also said it had agreed with Lufthansa Technik, of Berlin, Germany, to creat a Bombardier Aviation Services facility for all Bombardier business aircraft based in Europe and Africa.
A total of 185 Learjet and Challenger aircraft are currently based in Europe, Bombardier said.
